name: Tomato puree, packaged
storage: Keep unopened packs in a cool cupboard; refrigerate after opening in a closed glass or steel container and use within 2 to 3 days, or freeze in small portions.
looksLike: A thick, smooth red liquid in a small carton or tetra pack, without chunks or added ketchup.
howToPick: Read the label for "tomato puree" with only tomato and perhaps salt or acid, not ketchup with sugar and vinegar. A deep red colour and no leaking carton are good signs.
shelfLife: Several months unopened on the pack date; use within 2 to 3 days once opened (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Fresh tomatoes, blanched and blended (about 120 g per 80 g puree)
Tomato paste thinned with water (1 part to 2 parts)
mergeNotes: Range 115.0–158.0 was wider than 30% of avg 133.0; narrowed to ±15%.
